summary: Iteration 3 focused on the new public demo accounts (demo@salesmind.app / rep@salesmind.app). Created backend test suite covering login, stats, RBAC scoping, forbidden manager-only routes, and cross-workspace isolation. All 13 pytest cases pass. UI-verified demo manager and demo rep logins via the deployed frontend: manager lands on Overview with pipeline snapshot $84,000, contacts=4, companies=3, deals=5; rep lands with $32,000 open, 2 deals, 0 contacts, 0 companies, and NO Team nav item. Navigation works across Contacts/Companies/Deals/Sequences/Approvals for the manager without errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1356 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold from the code review guidelines; consider splitting into modules (auth, records, seed, ai) in a future refactor.

Login response returns the user document as the top-level object (no wrapping under `user` key). This is consistent with /api/auth/me but is worth documenting in an API spec so frontend clients don't assume { user: {...}, token }.
test_credentials: Demo manager demo@salesmind.app / Demo1234! ; Demo rep rep@salesmind.app / Demo1234! ; Admin govind.developer@kozker.com / SalesMind2026!
seed_data_creation: None created — used the app's built-in idempotent seed_demo_account() which pre-populated 4 contacts, 3 companies, 5 deals; 2 deals reassigned to the rep.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo accounts are stable and idempotently seeded on startup. RBAC scoping via record_scope() works: rep sees only owner_id-matched records; manager sees the whole workspace. Team + Invites are correctly manager-only (403 for rep, hidden in UI). Cross-tenant isolation verified between Demo Workspace and Kozker Sales admin workspace. Login endpoint returns the user object as top-level (no `user` wrapper). Future testers should keep using /app/backend/tests/test_demo_accounts.py as regression for demo login + RBAC.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues discovered this iteration.
